points.description: Meter table: states that it holds per-flow meter entries / collects flow statistics, used for monitoring and QoS-type management such as rate-limiting.
points.partial_credit: Half if only vaguely says it handles statistics or rate/QoS without clear link to flows or meters.

points.description: Flow pipeline: states that it is a series of flow tables holding rules/entries that decide how packets are forwarded or what actions are applied to them.
points.partial_credit: Half if only says it stores rules or does forwarding in vague terms.

rubric.notes: Award full marks when both the meter table and the flow pipeline are given a correct function, in any wording. Give part marks for vague but on-track statements (e.g. meter table is about statistics or rate limiting; flow tables have rules for packets). Give nothing for a part that is missing or swapped between the two tables.
